headline: BloomOS
speaker_note: Hero cover slide establishing BloomOS as a serious, infrastructure-grade plant intelligence platform. Speaker note focus: do not argue yet; simply set the tone with confidence, restraint, and local-first hardware plus intelligence.

headline: Redrawing the Category
speaker_note: Open the argument by repositioning BloomOS from plant gadget to integrated hardware-and-intelligence platform. Speaker notes: the category mistake is app-first thinking; BloomOS is infrastructure for living systems.

headline: The Friction Behind the Green Rush
speaker_note: Define the problem operationally: plant care fails because existing tools do not create dependable care loops. Speaker notes: avoid sentimental framing; highlight inconsistency, drop-off, and poor system design.

headline: BloomOS: The Closed Loop
speaker_note: Present the solution as a dependable closed loop between sensing, interpretation, and action. Speaker notes: this is the core mental model for the company and should feel simple, precise, and complete.

headline: BloomHub 8 System Architecture
speaker_note: Explain the hardware architecture concretely and make manufacturability feel grounded. Speaker notes: emphasize deterministic design, wall power, USB-C, and up to eight plant connections.

headline: Why Local-First Matters
speaker_note: Turn local-first from feature into irreducible reliability principle. Speaker notes: living systems cannot depend on brittle cloud logic; BloomOS survives network failure by design.

headline: Trusted Edge: Tethers and Intelligent Stakes
speaker_note: Show why BloomOS data quality and actuation quality start at the edge hardware, not in a generic app. Speaker notes: the tether system solves batteries, fragmentation, and trust.

headline: PAW Extends the System from Monitoring to Optimization
speaker_note: Introduce Plasma-Activated Water as a serious differentiated nutrition layer within the platform, not a gimmick. Speaker notes: be disciplined, mechanistic, and grounded.

headline: The Real Software Moat Is the Schema Library
speaker_note: Make the central software thesis explicit: BloomOS owns the validated interpretation layer, not any single AI model. Speaker notes: this is where investors should feel compounding defensibility.

headline: From Telemetry to Species-Aware Action
speaker_note: Demonstrate how BloomOS translates noisy biological data into bounded decisions rather than generic advice. Speaker notes: show process discipline and action boundaries.

headline: Early Stress Detection Before Visible Decline
speaker_note: Highlight the most compelling intelligence claim with mechanism, not hype. Speaker notes: focus on soil moisture decay dynamics and diurnal transpiration curves.

headline: Primary User Wedge, Secondary Resilience Market
speaker_note: Show that BloomOS has an attractive consumer entry point and a broader strategic adjacency via local-first resilience. Speaker notes: one core thesis, multiple constituencies.

headline: Proposed Product and Revenue Model
speaker_note: Provide a concrete commercial structure without overstating what is already launched. Speaker notes: hardware-first purchase, optional software layer, local utility preserved without subscription.

headline: Pilot Signal and Productization Path
speaker_note: Use the provided pilot data carefully while keeping the slide grounded in manufacturing next steps. Speaker notes: pilot proves demand and outcomes direction; the raise funds productization and scale.

headline: Why This Wins Against Fragile Alternatives
speaker_note: Sharpen the competitive contrast without inventing named competitors or unsupported claims. Speaker notes: compare architectures, not brands.

headline: Execution Priorities and Team Requirements
speaker_note: Address team and execution readiness without inventing founder biographies not present in source. Speaker notes: show the capability stack required to win and what seed capital unlocks.

headline: The Ask
speaker_note: Close with the funding ask, use of proceeds, and the strategic reason to invest now. Speaker notes: BloomOS is not a novelty gadget; it is a hardware-anchored intelligence platform with compounding schema defensibility.
